sources.full: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bound by Blood

entries.name: Kindred
entries: {@i A Vampiric Survivor Empowered by Blood}

Kindred are an ancient line of vampires who have existed since the first days of humanity. These vampires are innately social creatures who form their own socio-political sects and divisions, often based on clans and bloodlines. They gather for camaraderie and safety among the only beings who can understand the eternal hunger within.

Kindred draw their abilities, collectively known as vampiric Disciplines, from the supernatural power in their blood, which they more eloquently call vitae. The older and more powerful Kindred become, the more blood they can consume and concentrate within themselves, calling upon it to fuel their undead bodies and powers. These Disciplines allow them to do unbelievable things. They can possess intense strength, durability, or speed. They can transform into creatures of the night, or even mist. They can leash the wills of others. They can manipulate minds and perceptions. And they can reshape the darkness in which they are at home. Kindred can call upon truly terrifying powers, and they are all powered by vitae.

Kindred can develop in different ways, but as the centuries of their existence have proven, the clans and bloodlines carry specific aspects of their vampirism throughout the generations, from sire to childe. These manifest as each clan's ancient bane, the cost to be paid beyond just the endless hunger for blood and the struggle to keep at bay the Beast inside. There are Kindred in every walk of life, it seems, hiding in plain sight, acting like mortals, and maintaining their eternal Masquerade.

entries.name: Kindred and Other Species
entries: In the {@i Vampire: The Masquerade} (and the collective {@i World of Darkness}) setting, the vast majority of Kindred are human. While there might be the occasional plot-based variation, all Kindred characters are made using the human species.
In fifth edition games, however, since Kindred is a class, other species can be Kindred if GMs want to create vampiric options in their campaigns.

entries.name: Creating Kindred Characters in the World of Darkness
entries: In the {@i Vampire: The Masquerade}, Kindred are usually aware of their clan or bloodline soon after they are sired. In order to maintain game balance with other classes, levels 1 and 2 of the Kindred class are designed to represent the learning curve of becoming Kindred, a process that can take longer for some.

In a campaign set wholly in the {@i World of Darkness}, it is suggested that Kindred characters be created at level 3. This allows them to choose their clan or bloodline from the beginning of the game, and this may allow them to create lengthier backstories that can bring their {@i Vampire: The Masquerade} characters to life, proverbially speaking.

entries.name: Kindred or Cainite?
entries: In the Dark Ages setting, vampires do not yet call themselves Kindred. That term belongs to a later era, born from the political institutions that will eventually organize vampiric society across the modern nights. In the Dark Ages, vampires more commonly call themselves Cainites, tracing their lineage to Caine, the first of their kind.

The Kindred class is designed to work across any era in which vampires have existed. In modern nights, "Cainite" carries specific weight as the preferred term of the Sabbat sect, and using it as a catch-all can create confusion. Kindred is used here as a more neutral term for the class.

If you are playing in a Dark Ages campaign, feel free to have your character use Cainite at the table. The rules work the same either way. What you are, regardless of the century, is something that drinks blood and does not die easily.

classFeature.name: Feed
entries: You feed on the blood of other creatures. This is most often accomplished through your sharp fangs. As an action, you can feed on another creature within 5 feet of yourself if the target is willing, {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you, or has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, {@condition Stunned|XPHB}, or {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition. You can feed only once per turn.

When you feed, roll up to your maximum Feed Dice plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1). The creature takes Necrotic damage equal to the roll's total. This damage only reduces the creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum by an amount equal to the roll's total. The number of Feed Dice increases as you gain Kindred levels, as shown in the Feed Dice column of the Kindred Features table. If you roll a 6 on a d6 on a Feed Die, you can regain 1 expended Blood Point. If a creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced to 0, you can regain 1 expended Blood Point.

entries.name: Feeding from the Willing
entries: If you feed on a willing creature or a creature {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you, it can spend 1 {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}. It rolls the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} and reduces its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum by the amount rolled, and you can regain 1 expended Blood Point. Feeding in this way doesn't end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Hit Die Deficit
entries: If a creature has no remaining {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, the creature takes Necrotic damage equal to a roll of your Feed Dice plus your Constitution modifier, and the creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the roll's total.

entries.name: Maximum Successful Feedings
entries: A creature can provide a number of Blood Points based on its size. A Small creature provides 1 Blood Point, a Medium provides 3, a Large provides 5, a Huge provides 7, and a Gargantuan provides 10. A creature regains all lost Blood Points when it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Creature Susceptible to Feed
entries: You can feed on any creature with blood or other life-giving fluid. Aberrations, Beasts, Dragons, Fey, Giants, Monstrosities, and Humanoids are the most common targets. Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, and Plants usually don't have blood. Work with your GM to determine the types of creatures you can feed on.

entries.name: The Blood Bond
entries: A mysterious power in the blood of Kindred causes creatures to become Blood Bound to that Kindred when:

items: They drink from the same Kindred at least three times within one year.
At least one {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} occurs between each of the three drinks.

entries: While Blood Bound to a Kindred, a creature is considered {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by that Kindred and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid being {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} by other creatures. This is in addition to the effects from the {@item Kindred Vitae|BoundByBlood} consumable.

A Blood Bond can be suppressed for 1 minute if the creature succeeds on a DC 25 Charisma saving throw. The bond is only permanently removed if the creature doesn't drink from that Kindred again for a year, or if the Kindred in question is killed.

classFeature.name: The Beast
entries: You have a terrible Beast within that can only be sated with blood. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can use this Beast's predatory instincts to sharpen your senses and abilities. Until the start of your next turn, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} you make.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Hunger
entries: If a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} benefiting from your Beast feature fails, you go into a bloodlusted, hunger-driven state. This bloodlusted state ends after 1 minute or after you have successfully used your Feed feature, whichever comes first.

While bloodlusted, you regard the creature nearest to you that you can see or hear and that you can feed on as your prey. If there are multiple possible creatures, choose one at random. On each of your turns, you must move as close to the creature as possible and take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to grapple the target. If you're unable to get close enough to the creature to grapple it, your turn ends after you've used up all your available movement. If the creature dies or can no longer be seen or heard by you, the next nearest creature that you can see or hear and that you can feed on becomes your new target. If the target is in range and has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition at the start of your turn, you use your action to feed on it.

classFeature.name: Blood Potency
entries: You are fueled by blood, represented by Blood Points. Your Kindred level determines the number of points you have, as shown in the Blood Points column of the Kindred Features table. You can expend Blood Points in the following ways:

entries.name: Heal Wounds
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Blood Point to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Kindred level.

entries.name: Hunger Sated
entries: If you fail a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} that is affected by your Beast feature, you can expend 1 Blood Point to ignore the effects of {@classFeature The Beast|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1||Hunger}.

entries.name: Vitae Powers
entries: There are {@filter Kindred feats|feats|category=kf} and subclass features fueled by expending Blood Points.

classFeature.name: Kindred Biology
entries: You are a specific kind of vampire known as a Kindred, which brings physical benefits and drawbacks.

entries.name: Awaken
entries: You don't regain expended Blood Points when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. To gain the benefits of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you must have at least 1 Blood Point in your pool or you only gain the benefits of a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Sanguivore
entries: You can't eat food or drink. If you consume more than a nibble or sip, you have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition that ends once you expel what you consumed. While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} in this way, you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw every 10 minutes to avoid having the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, which lasts for 1 minute as you vomit up what you've consumed. The initial DC of this saving throw is 10, and it increases by 5 with each successive save.

Instead, you must consume a number of Blood Points per day equal to the number of pounds of food a creature your size normally requires per day (usually, 1 per day for Small and Medium creatures). You can expend 1 Blood Point to automatically succeed on the DC 10 Constitution saving throw to avoid gaining 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} from {@hazard Malnutrition|XPHB}.
Expending Blood Points to activate your Kindred features or Kindred Feats does not count towards the Blood Points you need to expend for sustenance.

entries.name: Sunlight Vulnerability
entries: You take 5 Radiant damage if you start your turn in sunlight.

entries.name: Supernatural Spellcasting
entries: Charisma is your spellcasting ability for spells from your Kindred subclass and Kindred feats, your spells require no Verbal or Somatic components, and they require no Material components unless they are consumed by the spell or have a cost specified in it; taking damage can't break your {@condition Concentration|XPHB}.

entries.name: Torpor
entries: If your {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level is 6, you aren't killed. Instead, you drop to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}, become {@condition Unconscious|XPHB}, and can't remove the condition until you have expended a number of Blood Points equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} over any length of time. Another creature can feed you while you are {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} to recover Blood Points, but the details of how that occurs is left for you and your GM to determine.

entries.name: Undead
entries: You have the Undead (Kindred) creature type in addition to your normal creature type. You don't age.

entries.name: Vampiric Resilience
entries: You automatically succeed on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}. Being reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by Fire or Radiant damage, or being beheaded kills you outright.

entries.name: Vampiric Vulnerabilities
entries: You have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Fire and Radiant damage.

entries.name: Wooden Stake Through the Heart
entries: When you are attacked with a wooden weapon that deals Piercing damage and you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or the attack roll is a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, you are staked through the heart and have the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition until the weapon is removed.

classFeature.name: Kindred Feat
entries: You gain a {@filter Kindred feat|feats|category=kf} of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Kindred levels 7, 10, 13, and 17.

classFeature.name: Kindred Subclass
entries: You gain a Kindred subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Kindred levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Kindred level or lower.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Kindred levels 8, 12, and 16.

classFeature.name: Bestial Fury
entries: Once per turn when you hit a target with a Melee weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can expend 2 uses of your {@classFeature The Beast|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1||Beast} feature to roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target. If this damage reduces it to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can't choose to leave the creature at 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} as per the "{@variantrule Knocking Out a Creature|XPHB}" rule.

entries.name: Bestial Flurry
entries: While affected by your {@classFeature The Beast|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1||Beast} feature, you can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn.

classFeature.name: Improved Feed
entries: You can use the {@classFeature Feed|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1} feature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. In addition, a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by you has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its checks to escape the grapple.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Kindred Subclass.

classFeature.name: Kindred Feat
entries: You gain a {@filter Kindred feat|feats|category=kf} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature

classFeature.name: Kindred Feat
entries: You gain a {@filter Kindred feat|feats|category=kf} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Vampiric Will
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition, and against effects that turn undead.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Kindred Subclass.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Kindred Feat
entries: You gain a {@filter Kindred feat|feats|category=kf} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Efficient Feeding
entries: Whenever you roll a die for your {@classFeature Feed|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1} feature, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Kindred Subclass.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Kindred Feat
entries: You gain a {@filter Kindred feat|feats|category=kf} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: You gain a feature from your Kindred Subclass.

classFeature.name: Epic Boon
entries: You gain an {@filter Epic Boon feat|feats|category=EB} or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Ancient Awakening
entries: The essence of the original vampiric Antediluvians has awoken in you. Pick four Ability Scores. Increase each chosen Ability Score by 2, to a maximum of 25.
If a Kindred subclass feature allows for an Ability Score to be increased beyond 25, Ancient Awakening can increase that Ability Score up to the maximum noted in that other feature.

subclass.name: Toreador
subclassFeatures: Live Fast, Be a Good Looking Corpse|Kindred|BoundByBlood|Toreador|BoundByBlood|9

subclassFeature.name: Brujah
entries: {@i Stand Up, Stand Firm, and Fight for Something}

The Brujah are a clan of freethinkers and revolutionaries who thrive on their own liberty and fight against oppression and stagnation. They find a power in themselves that is reflected as strength, speed, and a force of personality that makes them formidable in the varied conflicts they often find themselves in.

subclassFeature.name: Brujah Bane
entries: Your blood simmers with the rage of your vampiric ancestors. If you fail a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} that is affected by your {@classFeature The Beast|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1||Beast} feature and choose to expend Blood Points to ignore the effects of {@classFeature The Beast|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1||Hunger}, you must expend a number of Blood Points equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to ignore the effects, instead of 1.

subclassFeature.name: Fighting Fury
entries: You can channel the rage simmering below the surface, funneling it into your physical strength and speed. You can expend 1 Blood Point to gain the following benefits for 1 minute.

entries.name: Brawn
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the first attack roll you make with a Melee weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} on your turn.

entries.name: Swiftness
entries: You can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Dodge|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Weapon Training
entries: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons, and your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons of your choice.

subclassFeature.name: Fearsome
entries: Your vampiric presence exudes menace from the rise of your inner Beast.

entries.name: Dread Gaze
entries: You bare your fangs, your eyes flash with predatory hunger, and you let out a hiss that strikes terror in the hearts of others. You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Fear|XPHB} spell.

entries.name: Predatory Aura
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}) checks.

subclassFeature.name: Fleetness
entries: Your celerity grants you bursts of incredible speed.

entries.name: Dizzying Speed
entries: You can expend 3 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Haste|XPHB} spell on yourself. When you cast the spell in this way, when the spell ends, you aren't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} and your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} isn't reduced to 0.

subclassFeature.name: Burning Wrath
entries: You pour all of your intensity and fury into yourself, causing your blood to seemingly boil on your skin. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 2 Blood Points to empower your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. For 1 minute or until you fail to make an attack roll against an enemy on your turn, whichever comes first, you can deal an extra {@damage 2d8} Necrotic damage to a target you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Rouse Emotions
entries: You can extend your own passionate feelings into others, infecting them with your fervor. You can expend 3 Blood Points to cast one of the following spells.

entries.name: Enthrall
entries: You cast the {@spell Charm Person|XPHB} spell as if with a level 6 spell slot, and the creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw.

entries.name: Incite
entries: You cast the {@spell Confusion|XPHB} spell. A creature that fails its saving throw automatically rolls 7-8 to determine its behavior for each turn.

entries.name: Terrorize
entries: You cast the {@spell Fear|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@condition Concentration|XPHB} and creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw.

subclassFeature.name: Puissant Might
entries: Your raw, supernatural strength is legendary.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 4, to a maximum of 30.

entries.name: Pulverize
entries: When you hit a target with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, your Melee weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} deals two extra dice of its damage.

subclassFeature.name: Gangrel
entries: {@i Let the Beast Inside in Order to Control It}

The Gangrel have made peace with their Beast long ago, choosing to harness the wild power it promises and wield it rather than trying to stifle it. They are attuned to its feral nature, embodying the predator.

subclassFeature.name: Gangrel Bane
entries: The Beast reveals itself in you as animalistic features and behaviors. If you are affected by the {@classFeature The Beast|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1||Hunger} of your Beast feature, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB} and {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) checks until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Gifts of the Beast
entries: Your body reflects the protean gifts of your animalistic Beast. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Eyes of the Beast
entries: The range of your {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} increases to 240 feet.

entries.name: Feral Weapons
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Blood Point to grow rending claws for 1 minute. Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} deal {@damage 2d6} Slashing damage, and you can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}.

subclassFeature.name: Feral Spirit
entries: Your connection to your wild self forges a spiritual bridge with Beasts.

entries.name: Beastmind
entries: While you look in the eyes of a Beast within 30 feet of yourself, you can speak telepathically with it, and you can use any of the {@action Influence|XPHB} action's skill options with it.

entries.name: Like Minds
entries: You can cast the {@spell Animal Friendship|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot. And when you cast the spell in this way, it is cast as if you had used a spell slot level equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Wild Hunger
entries: When you are affected by the {@classFeature The Beast|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1||Hunger} of your Beast feature, you can deal {@damage 1d6} extra Slashing damage when you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, and you also count as one size larger when determining what you can grapple.

subclassFeature.name: Gifts of Survival
entries: Your body is built to survive whatever the world sets before you.

entries.name: Feral Fortitude
entries: When you take damage except Fire and Radiant, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce the damage taken by your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Constitution modifier (minimum reduction of 1).

entries.name: Meld with Earth
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Meld into Stone|XPHB} spell, except the surface must be dirt, sand, or clay instead of stone. Additionally, while the spell is active, you gain {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. The spell lasts until you end it (no action required) or when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Corporeal Mastery
entries: You embody the supernatural powers of ancient vampire legends, transforming for a time.

entries.name: Beast Form
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend a number of Blood Points to shape-shift into a Beast form applicable to this feature (see "Known Forms" below). You stay in that form for a number of hours equal to half your Kindred level or until you use Corporeal Mastery again, have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or die. You can also leave the form early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Known Forms
entries: You can expend 2 Blood Points to shape-shift into a {@creature Bat|XMM}, {@creature Cat|XMM}, {@creature Rat|XMM}, {@creature Raven|XMM}, or {@creature Wolf|XMM}. You can expend 4 Blood Points to shape-shift into a {@creature Dire Wolf|XMM}, {@creature Giant Bat|XMM}, {@creature Giant Rat|XMM}, or {@creature Panther|XMM}.

entries.name: Temporary Hit Points
entries: When you assume a Beast form, you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Kindred level.

entries.name: Game Statistics
entries: Your game statistics are replaced by the Beast's stat block, but you retain your creature type; {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}; {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; class features; languages; and feats. You also retain your skill and saving throw proficiencies and use your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} for them, in addition to gaining the proficiencies of the creature. If a skill or saving throw modifier in the Beast's stat block is higher than yours, use the one in the stat block. While in Beast form, you retain your personality and memories, and you can understand languages you know, but you can't speak.

entries.name: Objects
entries: Your ability to handle objects is determined by the form's limbs rather than your own. In addition, your equipment merges into your new form. Nonmagical equipment that merges with the form has no effect while you're in that form.

subclassFeature.name: Command the Beast
entries: You can impose your will upon wild things, allowing your Beast to overwhelm theirs.

entries.name: Rein
entries: You cast the {@spell Dominate Beast|XPHB} spell as its level 7 version, without expending a spell slot, and you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@condition Concentration|XPHB}.
Once you cast the spell with this feature, you can't do so in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Rouse
entries: When an Undead (Kindred) you can see within 30 feet of you is about to make a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend 1 Blood Point to force that creature to use its {@classFeature The Beast|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1||Beast} feature on that {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}. If the Kindred has no remaining uses of its {@classFeature The Beast|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1||Beast} feature, this effect automatically fails.

subclassFeature.name: Protean Rewards
entries: Your body can perform greater wonders.

entries.name: Flesh of Marble
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 2 Blood Points to double your {@subclassFeature Gifts of Survival|Kindred|BoundByBlood|Gangrel|BoundByBlood|9} feature's Damage Reduction for 1 minute.

entries.name: Mistform
entries: You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Gaseous Form|XPHB} spell on yourself. When you cast the spell in this way, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@condition Concentration|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Lasombra
entries: {@i Manipulate Darkness and Weakness with Ease}
Kindred are creatures of darkness, but none so much as the Lasombra. They are masters infused with the inky abyss from which they draw their power, turning shadows into an extension of themselves.

subclassFeature.name: Lasombra Bane
entries: Lasombra don't tolerate failure, especially their own. When you roll a 1 on the {@dice d20} of a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} you make within 1 minute.

subclassFeature.name: Taste of Oblivion
entries: You are infused with the essence of darkness itself, gaining the following benefits.

entries.name: Oblivion's Sight
entries: You can see normally in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} and {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}—both magical and nonmagical—within 120 feet of yourself.

entries.name: Shadow Cloak
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks, and you can take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Shadow Mastery
entries: You can call forth different aspects of the abyssal darkness.

entries.name: Arms of Ahriman
entries: You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Evard's Black Tentacles|XPHB|Black Tentacles} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, the {@spell Evard's Black Tentacles|XPHB|Black Tentacles} deal {@damage 1d6} Bludgeoning damage and {@damage 2d6} Cold damage (instead of {@damage 3d6} Bludgeoning damage)

entries.name: Shrouding
entries: You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Darkness|XPHB} spell.

subclassFeature.name: Force of Will
entries: You can focus your will upon others in a mental vise of your supernatural dominance.

entries.name: Mesmerize
entries: You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} spell.

entries.name: Shhh ...
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 Blood Point to mentally lull a creature that you can see within 15 feet of yourself to sleep. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or gain the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition for 10 minutes. The effect ends if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet takes an action to shake it out of the effect. Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} condition automatically succeed on saves against this effect.

subclassFeature.name: Abyssal Strength
entries: You are a creature of darkness able to tap into a fierce wellspring of physical power.

entries.name: Monstrous Might
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 2 Blood Points to increase your Strength score by an amount equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} for 1 minute.

subclassFeature.name: Crush Weakness
entries: You abhor failure and weakness in all its forms, and you relish punishing those who succumb to it. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dark Judgment
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails an ability check or saving throw, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend 2 Blood Points to deal {@damage 4d8} Psychic damage to that creature.

entries.name: Obliviate
entries: When a creature that you can see within 10 feet of you misses an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend 2 Blood Points to deal {@damage 2d8} Bludgeoning damage and {@damage 2d8} Cold damage to that creature.

subclassFeature.name: Tenebrous Form
entries: Your body can be wreathed in a whirling, armored skin of tangible darkness. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 5 Blood Points to assume a Tenebrous Form for 1 minute. While in your Tenebrous Form, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Armored by Darkness
entries: You have a +4 bonus to AC.

entries.name: Dark Vigor
entries: You gain {@dice 4d10} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Extend Shadows
entries: You can expend 1 Blood Point to increase the duration of Tenebrous Form by 1 minute.

entries.name: Power of Oblivion
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength and Constitution checks and saving throws.

entries.name: Shadowstep
entries: You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} spell, but the unoccupied space you travel to must be in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}.

entries.name: Umbral Limbs
entries: When you make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, your reach is 5 feet greater than normal, you can deal an extra {@damage 2d10} Cold damage to a target you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, and you can grapple a creature if it is Huge or smaller.

subclassFeature.name: Nosferatu
entries: {@i Hide Yourself from Prying Eyes and Unleash Your Own Monstrous Nature}

Nosferatu undergo a tragic transformation upon becoming Kindred. Their visage is warped to represent the Beast inside, making them into a terror who forges connections only with vermin and monsters. They must overcome this adversity with their gifts, lest they become the monsters they resemble.

entries.name: Mask of a Thousand Faces
entries: You can cast the {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot.

entries.name: Vanish
entries: You can cast the {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Nosferatu Bane
entries: Your physical appearance is monstrous and unsettling. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks when interacting with non-Undead that can see your hideous visage.

subclassFeature.name: Monstrous Gifts
entries: You have become more at peace with your monstrous appearance, unlocking aspects of yourself. You can choose two benefits from the following list.

entries.name: Animalist
entries: You can cast the {@spell Animal Friendship|XPHB}, {@spell Animal Messenger|XPHB}, and {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} spells. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast each spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Ears of the Bat
entries: You have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Feral Talons
entries: You have a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and when you hit with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} and deal damage, you can deal Slashing damage equal to {@damage 1d8} plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

entries.name: Leathery Hide
entries: Damage dealt to you except Fire and Radiant is reduced by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum reduction of 1).

entries.name: Patagia
entries: If you aren't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} or wearing Heavy armor, you can extend your skin to glide. When you fall, you can move up to 5 feet horizontally for every 1 foot you descend, and when you would take damage from a fall, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce the fall's damage to 0.

entries.name: The Terror
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can reveal your monstrous nature to up to three creatures you can see within 30 feet. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or gain the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute, or until you deal damage to it.

subclassFeature.name: Inhuman Strength
entries: Your supernatural strength is as potent as your apperance is horrifying.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, to a maximum of 25.

entries.name: Powerful Blows
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, expend 3 Blood Points for 1 minute. When you hit with a Melee weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d10} Force damage.

subclassFeature.name: The Concealing
entries: Your obfuscation abilities can now extend to objects and creatures in your vicinity.

entries.name: Conceal
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action you can expend 3 Blood Points to touch an object and make it vanish from sight and memory. The object gains the Invisible condition and creatures forgetting it may recover memories by succeeding on the Investigation check described in the source. A {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} or {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} restores true memory.

entries.name: Cloak the Gathering
entries: When you cast {@spell Invisibility|XPHB}, you can expend up to 6 Blood Points to affect additional creatures within 30 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Greater Monstrous Gifts
entries: Your physical monstrousness has evolved. You can choose one benefit from the following list.

entries.name: Call the Wretched
entries: You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Blight|XPHB} or {@spell Insect Plague|XPHB} spell.

entries.name: Distending Jaws
entries: You can roll one additional Feed Die when you feed. In addition, you can use your jaws to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. When you hit with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} and deal damage, you can deal Piercing damage equal to {@damage 2d6} plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

entries.name: One with the Night
entries: Your {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} is increased to 90 feet, and you can see normally in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} and {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}—both magical and nonmagical—within 120 feet of yourself.

entries.name: Skin of the Chameleon
entries: You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Greater Invisibility|XPHB} spell. In addition, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Stony Flesh
entries: In response to taking damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend 1 Blood Point to gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} for 1 minute to two damage types, other than Fire, Psychic, and Radiant, including against the triggering damage.

entries.name: Wings of the Gargoyle
entries: While you aren't wearing Heavy armor, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet, and you gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: What Goes Bump in the Night

entries.name: Lord of Vermin
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action expend 3 Blood Points to summon {@dice 1d4 + 1} swarms of bats, insects, or rats for 1 hour. Once used, can't use again until a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Stalk the Shadows
entries: You can cast {@spell Greater Invisibility|XPHB} on yourself without a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining uses on a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Toreador
entries: {@i See the World Like No One Else Can}

Toreador are steeped in art and beauty. They use their superhuman senses to experience aspects of the world no one else can. They feel everything deeply, and, with a glance or a few words, can instill similar feelings in others. If there is awe to be found, a Toreador can find it.

subclassFeature.name: An Artist's Soul
entries: You have in you a spark of talent and inspiration that has only been fanned brighter by your vampiric ascension. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Auspicious Senses
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks. In addition, the range of your {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} increases to 120 feet.

entries.name: Chosen for Talent
entries: You gain proficiency in two skills and one tool of your choice. If you already have proficiency in the chosen skill, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it.

subclassFeature.name: Toreador Bane
entries: You suffer a great malaise in the absence of beauty. When you roll a 9 or lower on the d20 for an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) or Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check, you see nothing of immediate beauty and gain the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. At the end of each of your turns, you can make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw, ending the condition on a success.

subclassFeature.name: Depth of Feelings
entries: You can see aspects of the world that others can't, including emotions. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Aura Sight
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 2 Blood Points to see a creature's aura for 1 minute. You can ask the GM up to two questions that can be answered with yes or no. You must ask your questions before the effect ends. You receive a correct answer for each question. The following are example questions.

items: Is the creature's creature type X? (Where X is a creature type specified by the player character, such as Monstrosity or Undead)
Can the creature cast spells?
Is the creature {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} toward me?
Does the creature believe what it is saying?

entries: The GM has final say as to whether the question can be answered, but the answers must be truthful.

entries.name: Entrancement
entries: You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Calm Emotions|XPHB}, {@spell Charm Monster|XPHB}, or {@spell Charm Person|XPHB} spell.

subclassFeature.name: Live Fast, Be a Good Looking Corpse
entries: You experience the world, in all its wonders, with vampiric speed. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, to a maximum of 25.

entries.name: Rapidity
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Blood Point to gain an additional action on your turns. That action can be used to take only the {@action Attack|XPHB} (one attack only), {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, {@action Hide|XPHB}, or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action. This effects lasts for a number of turns equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

subclassFeature.name: Visionary
entries: You have honed your skills and your perceptions to a razor's edge. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Practiced Perfection
entries: You gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in three of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

entries.name: Spirit's Touch
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 2 Blood Points to touch an object and perceive emotional residues on it for 10 minutes. You can ask the GM a number of questions equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, which must be answered truthfully. You must ask your questions before the effect ends. The following are examples of questions that can be asked.

items: What did the last creature that touched this look like?
What was the emotional state of the last creature that used the object?
Is this object magical?
Is this object cursed?
Is this object trapped?
What are any physical details of the object that aren't readily visible?
How many creatures have touched the object in the last 24 hours?

subclassFeature.name: Truly Majestic
entries: You exude vampiric allure and have learned how to charm others. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Eerily Convincing
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB} and {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) checks. In addition, when you cast a spell with your Entrancement feature, a creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on any saving throw it makes against the spell.

entries.name: Majesty
entries: You can expend 3 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Sanctuary|XPHB} spell on yourself. When you cast the spell in this way, the spell doesn't end if you make an attack roll, cast a spell, or deal damage.

subclassFeature.name: Magnum Opus
entries: You have mastered what it means to be one of the greatest vampiric artisans, which defines you as much as you define it. Choose two of the following benefits.

entries.name: Flicker
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 3 Blood Points to dance between the beats of a mortal's heart. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +3 bonus to AC, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is doubled, your movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls.

entries.name: Clairvoyance
entries: You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Clairvoyance|XPHB} or {@spell Scrying|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, the sensor can't be perceived.

entries.name: Open Mind
entries: You can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to expend 1 Blood point to choose any number of creatures you know within 5 miles of yourself or any number of creatures you can see within 120 feet of yourself. You and the chosen creatures can communicate telepathically with each other while the creatures and you are within 5 miles of each other for 8 hours. You and the targets can instantly share words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages with each other through the link, and the targets recognize you as the creature they are communicating with. This effect enables creatures to understand the meaning of your words and any sensory messages you send to them.

entries.name: Star Magnetism
entries: You can expend 3 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Mass Suggestion|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, you can target any creature you can communicate with, you don't need line of sight, the range becomes 1 mile, and you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@condition Concentration|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Ventrue
entries: {@i Control Others with Influence and Guile}

The Ventrue have elevated themselves to be the "Clan of Kings," imposing their will on the clans and standing contemptuously against those who would defy them. After lifetimes of prudent rule, the Ventrue have earned their figurative throne.

subclassFeature.name: Voice of Authority
entries: You can impose control over others while keeping others from imposing control over you. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Do as I Say
entries: You can cast the {@spell Command|XPHB} and {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} spells. You can cast either spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Unshakably Confident
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom saving throws.

subclassFeature.name: Ventrue Bane
entries: You have an arguably refined palate for blood. Choose a specific physical aspect (such as natural blondes or the elderly) or a social aspect (such as employees, soldiers, or the willing). It cannot be a wide generalization, such as creature type. When you use your {@classFeature Feed|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1} feature on a creature that doesn't have your preferred aspect, you roll half the number of Feed Dice.

subclassFeature.name: Dare Not Falter
entries: You effortlessly shrug off harm to your body and mind. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Toughened
entries: Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by an amount equal to your Kindred level when you gain this feature. Whenever you gain a Kindred level thereafter, your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by an additional 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

entries.name: Unswayable Mind
entries: If you fail a saving throw to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, or {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition, you can reroll it. You must use the new roll.

subclassFeature.name: Domineering Control
entries: With a glance, you can steer the emotions and thoughts of intelligent creatures.

entries.name: Befuddle
entries: You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Hypnotic Pattern|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, a creature with an Intelligence of 3 or lower automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the spell while a creature with an Intelligence of 4 or higher has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw.

entries.name: Entrance
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check and expend 2 Blood Points to choose a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw with a DC equal to the result of your {@skill Persuasion|XPHB} check. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn. At the end of each of the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} creature's turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature with an Intelligence of 3 or lower automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the effect.

entries.name: Persuade
entries: You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Charm Monster|XPHB} spell.

entries.name: Terrify
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}) check and expend 1 Blood Point to choose a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw with a DC equal to the result of your {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} check. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} creature's turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature with an Intelligence of 3 or lower automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the effect.

subclassFeature.name: Mass Manipulation
entries: Your ability to command and sway others grows to encompass multiple minds at once. You can expend 3 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Mass Suggestion|XPHB} spell. At level 15, you can expend 4 Blood Points to cast the spell as its level 7 version; at level 18, you can expend 5 Blood Points to cast it as its level 8 version; and at level 20, you can expend 6 Blood Points to cast it as its level 9 version.

subclassFeature.name: Sanguine Fortification
entries: Your vitae has resilience-enhancing properties. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Draught of Endurance
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of you drinks your vitae, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend 2 Blood Points to grant that creature a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your Kindred level.

entries.name: Flesh of Marble
entries: When you take damage except Fire and Radiant, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend 2 Blood Points to reduce the damage you take by half (round down) or 4 Blood Points to reduce the damage to 0.

subclassFeature.name: Lordly Power
entries: Your will over others becomes ironclad and staggeringly powerful. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Imposing Aura
entries: When a creature within 15 feet of you targets you with an attack roll or a damaging spell, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or either choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. On a successful save, the target isn't affected, and it's immune to Imposing Aura for 24 hours.

entries.name: Penetrating Dominance
entries: Creatures you can see within 60 feet of yourself have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Summon
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 3 Blood Points to urge a Beast, Humanoid, or Undead you have touched and is on the same plane of existence as you to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, the creature is compelled to come to you. The creature must use as much of its movement as possible to move in your direction on its turns, taking the safest route, and stopping only to eat and rest. A compelled creature repeats the save at the end of each day at dusk, ending the effect on itself on a success. You know if the compulsion ends early. You can't have more than one creature under this effect at a time. If you use this feature again, the effect on another creature ends.

When the creature appears, it is under no compulsion to behave a particular way. You can ask it to perform a service in exchange for payment, but it isn't obliged to do so. The requested task could range from simple (fly us across the chasm, or help us fight a battle) to complex (spy on our enemies, or protect us during our foray into the dungeon). You must be able to communicate with the creature to bargain for its services. Payment can take a variety of forms.

The GM can adjust these payments based on the circumstances under which you called upon it. If the task is aligned with the creature's ethos, the payment might be halved or even waived. Nonhazardous tasks typically require only half the payment, while especially dangerous tasks might require a greater gift. Creatures rarely accept tasks that seem suicidal.
A {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB}, {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, or {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell ends this effect.

items.name: Tool Proficiency:
items.entry: Choose one kind of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} (same as above), {@item Dagger|XPHB}, {@item Kindred Vitae|BoundByBlood}, {@item Hooded Lantern|XPHB}, {@item Shortbow|XPHB}, 20 {@item Arrow|XPHB|Arrows}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB}, {@item Book|XPHB} (rituals), {@item Dagger|XPHB}, {@item Ink|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 9 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Tool Proficiency:
items.entry: Choose one kind of {@item Gaming Set|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Gaming Set|XPHB} (same as above), {@item Manacles|XPHB}, {@item Mirror|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 15 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Tool Proficiency:
items.entry: Choose one kind of {@item Gaming Set|XPHB} or {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Gaming Set|XPHB} or {@item Musical Instrument|XPHB} (same as above), {@item Healer's Kit|XPHB}, {@item Bullseye Lantern|XPHB}, {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 32 GP; or (B) 50 GP

items.name: Tool Proficiency:
items.entry: Choose one kind of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB}

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Choose A or B: (A) {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} (same as above), {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

trait.name: Traps (3/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The first time an enemy with a {@variantrule Passive Perception|XPHB} of 12 or lower comes within 30 feet of the trapper or the trapper shoves the creature 5 feet. {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Piercing damage and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Each failed check deals {@damage 1d4} Piercing damage to the trapped creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The trapper makes two attacks, using Greataxe or Short Bow in any combination.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 80/320 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Shove
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 13}, one Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of the trapper. {@actSaveFail} The creature is pushed 5 feet directly away from the trapper.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Torch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) Fire damage.

action.name: Wooden Pitchfork
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The villager militia makes two attacks, using Dagger, Spear, or Torch in any combination.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Torch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Fire damage.

trait.name: Faith
entries: When the monster hunter rolls a 1 on the {@dice d20} of an ability check or saving throw, it can reroll the die, and it must use the new roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The monster hunter makes two attacks, using Handaxe or Silver Knife in any combination.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage, plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Slashing damage if the attack roll was made with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Silver Knife
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage, plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Slashing damage if the attack roll was made with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Wooden Stake
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Aim
entries: The monster hunter gives itself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes during the current turn.

reaction.name: Save Ally
entries: {@actTrigger} An ally within 5 feet has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition. {@actResponse} The ally can immediately make an escape roll with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Rage
entries: The lupine can give itself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its first {@dice D20} Test each turn. If it does so and fails that {@dice D20} Test, it's overcome with rage. On each of its turns while raging, the lupine attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, its rage ends. A lupine's ally, if within 60 feet of the raging lupine, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check; the lupine must be able to hear its ally. If this check succeeds, the lupine ceases its rage.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The lupine regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the lupine takes Fire damage or damage from silver objects, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The lupine dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lupine makes two attacks, using Battleaxe, Rend, or Longbow in any combination. If it hits with a Rend attack, the lupine can make one Bite attack against the same target as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

action.name: Battleaxe (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Rend (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Horrifying Howl {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 14}, each creature within 60 feet that can hear the howl and isn't a lupine. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The lupine shape-shifts into a Large wolf-humanoid hybrid form or a Medium wolf, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The highland wolf has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the highland wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

monsterFluff.name: Highland Wolf
entries: Large packs of wolves hunt across the highlands, rarely choosing to interact with humans. When food becomes scarce or when travelers become separated from their groups, these thickly furred canines become a deadly threat.

monsterFluff.name: Lupine
entries: Werewolves, or what Kindred call the lupines, are another powerful denizen of the supernatural world. Lupines are overwhelmingly strong, terrifyingly fast, immensely resilient, and have held a frenzied level of hatred for the Kindred for as long as either side can remember. When one is not taking the shape of a human or a wolf, it stands on two legs to become a ten-foot-tall killing machine of fur, claws, and fangs who can split stone with a single slash and endure horrific amounts of damage. A single lupine is more than a match for a group of younger Kindred, and even powerful Kindred are wise to give pause before engaging unprepared.

monsterFluff.name: Trapper
entries: A skilled hunter and survivalist who makes a living trapping and skinning animals in the wilderness. They effectively spread traps around them when ambushing prey.

monsterFluff.name: Villager
entries: The common people of the village are generally useful to Kindred as a source to subtly feed upon. When afraid or angry enough to fight, a villager can be quite dangerous, especially in groups.

monsterFluff.name: Villager Militia
entries: These brave folk take up arms to defend their village against bandits, invaders, and sometimes beasts lurking in their midst.

monsterFluff.name: Monster Hunter
entries: Armed with a variety of skills, tools, and beliefs, the monster hunter pursues supernatural threats wherever they hide. Whether a hunter knows real lore or just superstitious stories about the Kindred doesn't make the hunter any less deadly.

item.name: Kindred Vitae
entries: Vitae, blood from within a Kindred, has powerful properties that are passed on when imbibed by a non-Kindred. A single Blood Point can be stored in a drinkable vessel for up to 48 hours without alchemical treatment. When you drink this potion, you gain the following effects.

entries.name: Increased Strength and Speed:
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 5 feet for 1 week.

entries.name: Increased Vitality:
entries: You gain {@dice 2d6} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Reduced Aging:
entries: You physically ignore the next year of natural aging.

However, mortals who drink this potion are more susceptible to the powers of the Undead. For the period of 1 year, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws against being {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} by Undead.

item.name: Hunter's Kit
entries: Sometimes called a "vampire hunting kit," the Hunter's Kit contains the following items: 6 {@item Candle|XPHB|Candles}, {@item Crowbar|XPHB}, {@item Holy Symbol|XPHB}, 2 vials of {@item Holy Water|XPHB}, {@item Backpack|XPHB}, {@item Mirror|XPHB}, 4 {@item Torch|XPHB|Torches}, and {@item Wooden Stake|BoundByBlood|Wooden Stakes}

item.name: Leather Undervest
entries: These layered leather patches are worn under clothing or armor. The vest fits over the upper chest and back, protecting several internal organs from puncture, particularly the heart. While wearing a leather undervest, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Underarmor
entries: The leather undervest can be worn with any type of armor.

entries.name: Limited Flexibility
entries: The undervest allows a max Dexterity modifier of 3.

entries.name: Pierce Protection
entries: When you're hit by an attack while you're wearing a leather undervest, any Piercing damage dealt to you by that attack is reduced by 2. In addition, Intelligence ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) checks to stake you in the heart have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

item.name: Wooden Stake
entries: While any modest length of sharpened wood can be used as an improvised weapon, wooden stakes that have been carved, treated, and fire-hardened are specifically useful against {@class Kindred|BoundByBlood}. Dedicated wooden stakes use the weapon profile below.

entries.name: Driving the Stake
entries: If you are within 5 feet of a {@class Kindred|BoundByBlood} with the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} or {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition, you can take an action to make a DC 15 Intelligence ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check. On a successful check, the wooden stake is driven into the heart of the {@class Kindred|BoundByBlood}.

entries.name: Wooden Ammunition
entries: Wooden ammunition is destroyed after hitting or missing a target.

entries.name: Upkeep
entries: When you make an attack roll with a silver weapon or piece of ammunition, it takes a cumulative -1 penalty to attack rolls. The weapon or piece of ammunition is destroyed if the penalty reaches -5. The penalty can be removed by casting the {@spell Mending|XPHB} spell on the object or by succeeding on a DC 10 Dexterity check using {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB} as part of a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
